{"code": "import re
seq=''.join(l.strip() for l in open('region.fasta') if not l.startswith('>'))
rc = seq.translate(str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA'))[::-1]
STOPS={'TAA','TAG','TGA'}
def runlen(s,start):
    n=0;i=start
    while i+3<=len(s):
        if s[i:i+3] in STOPS: return n
        n+=1;i+=3
    return n
cands=[('fwd',646),('fwd',742),('fwd',872),('fwd',1231),('fwd',1790),('fwd',2189),('fwd',2294),('fwd',2621),

    hept=s[p:p+7]
    # P-site codon = p+1..p+3, its frame
    f=(p+1)%3
    # 0-frame codons after
    c=[]
    i=p+1
    while i+3<=p+40:
        c.append(s[i:i+3]); i+=3
    # shifted frame = f-1 for -1 shift; starts at p (b1)
    sf=(p)%3
